tiebreak: the K=10 tie-break permutations of compounding_experiment.run_model, replayed from the same seeded generator (stable_seed(reranker, 'slates')), so every statistic uses the same draws as compounding_bge_pipeline.json

name_occupancy.definition: Share (%) of the slots at each stage taken by each of the 20 names, over the 832 pools and the 200 tie-break draws: pipeline top-3 (retriever keeps 10, re-ranker shortlists 3), re-ranker-alone top-3, retriever top-10. Under no name effect every name would hold 5%. `effective_n_names` is 1 / sum(share^2).

leave_one_pair_out.definition: Drop one of the 10 name pairs (both documents), leaving pools of 18; retriever still keeps 10, re-ranker still shortlists 3; same tie-break draws restricted to the surviving documents.

name_pair_bootstrap.definition: Percentile 95% intervals for the pipeline % male-associated in the top-3. name_pair_only: the 10 name pairs are resampled with replacement (a repeated pair appears twice, as separate documents with identical scores), pools are rebuilt and the simulation rerun with the same 200 tie-break draws per pool. joint_occupation_name_pair: the 52 occupations and the 10 pairs are resampled independently in each draw (a category's interval resamples that category's occupations, as the paper's does). occupation_only: the interval the paper prints (occupations resampled, names fixed), read from compounding_bge_pipeline.json and recomputed here from the replayed per-pool counts with the same seed.

rank_gap_baselines.definition: Rank gap = mean rank of female-associated minus male-associated documents in the 20-document pool (rank 1 = top; + means the woman sits lower). retriever_alone: positions 1-20 by the retriever (= slate.*.emb_gap). order_neutral_reranker: the retriever keeps its top 10; every retrieved document gets the expected rank 5.5; positions 11-20 keep their retriever order. It is what a re-ranker with no gender preference would show in Table A4's rank-gap column, and it is the same for every re-ranker because all sit behind the same retriever and pools (the retriever has no tied scores in any pool: 0 pools with ties). For the top-3 share, retriever_alone = the retriever's own top-3 (slate.*.emb_top3_m) and order_neutral_reranker = the male share of the retrieved top-10 (slate.*.retrieved_m), since 3 of 10 are then drawn at random.
